meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

howto.what: 当用户询问某条 senpi 提示（Tip: 行、启动提示或工作提示）时，Claude 会先实时查询提示列表，检查用户实际能看到的提示，然后深入解释该提示背后的机制，包括具体代码路径、触发条件和工作原理。
howto.when: 当用户提到“give-me-tips”、询问某条提示行是什么意思、某个提示特性如何工作、或问自己能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 解释一下刚才那条提示是什么意思。
say.note: Claude 会查询当前可用的提示列表并深入解释那条提示。

say.text: 帮我看看我现在能看到哪些 senpi 提示？
say.note: Claude 会列出你当前上下文下实际可见的提示。

say.text: 那个 Fable-5 拒绝后的回退提示是怎么工作的？

howto.what_en: When you ask about any senpi tip (Tip: line, startup tip, or working tip), Claude queries the live tip list first, checks which tips you can actually see, then gives a deep explanation of the underlying mechanism, including concrete code paths, trigger conditions and how it works.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "give-me-tips", ask what a Tip: line means, how a tipped feature works, or what tips you can see.

say_en.note: Claude queries the live tip list and explains that tip in depth.

say_en.text: What tips can I currently see?
say_en.note: Claude lists the tips you personally can encounter in this context.
